# Requirements

## Requirement product: Complete approved UI

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Production redesign of full OSS and hosted UI from approved conceptual demo, actual use of all 150 requested assistant-ui surfaces, and hosted Windows Electron client. Demo is design reference only. No broad backend rewrite or new business-service integrations inferred from decorative template examples.

## Requirement windows: Hosted Windows app

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Windows x64 NSIS executable, Gideon product identity/icon, checksum manifest, installation/start/uninstall evidence. Build cross-platform through Node script; use Windows runner for native qualification. No update server or signing claim without configured service/credentials.
